evidence.quoted_text:
def atomic(filename, data):
    filename = Path(filename)
    durable_directory(filename.parent)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
    fsync_dir(filename.parent)
evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, atomic() creates a delete=False temporary staging file but records its path only after write, flush, and fsync succeed. If any of those operations or os.replace() raises, the staging file remains on disk with no cleanup, so repeated failures can accumulate garbage. This is an ordinary implementation defect in the intended atomic-write behavior, not a proposal for new scope.
